en.name: Schedule
en.description: The Schedule tab: today’s classes, to-dos and reminders, plus a weekly timetable and the forms behind them.

plugins.author: pkuinfo

en.name: Date and academic calendar
en.description: Today’s date, weekday and teaching week, plus Peking University’s official academic calendar (term start, holidays, exam weeks). Sets your timetable’s semester in one tap.

plugins.author: pkuinfo

plugins.name: 校园钱包
plugins.description: 校园卡余额与付款码、充值，网费、电费、水费、浴卡（原「校园卡」「网费」「水电浴」合并）。

en.name: Campus wallet
en.description: Campus Card balance and payment code, top-ups, network fee, electricity, water and bath card.

plugins.author: pkuinfo

plugins.name: 付款码共享
plugins.description: 把校园卡付款码临时分享给朋友：端到端加密转发，可设消费上限、口令和姓名验证，随时停止。

en.name: Share payment code
en.description: Lend your Campus Card payment code to a friend for a while: end-to-end encrypted relay, optional spend cap, PIN and name check, stop at any time.

plugins.author: pkuinfo

zh: 分享期间，加密后的付款码经云服务转发给你分享的人；服务器无法解密
服务器能看到：分享的开始/结束时间、查看者的 IP
en: While you share, encrypted payment codes are relayed by the cloud service to the person you shared with; the server can’t decrypt them
The server can see when a share starts and ends, and the viewer’s IP address

plugins.name: 教学网

en.name: Course (教学网)
en.description: Blackboard (教学网): announcements, assignments (due dates, requirements, grades), submissions, your grades, deadlines synced to to-dos, course materials and lecture recordings.

en.description: Search every course at Peking University by name, teacher or department, with class times (Elective searches include rooms). Read-only.

plugins.author: pkuinfo

plugins.name: 成绩

en.name: Grades
en.description: Your grades and GPA, semester by semester.

plugins.name: 树洞

en.name: Treehole
en.description: PKU Treehole (树洞): browse, search and read posts, follow them, and post or reply anonymously.

plugins.author: pkuinfo

plugins.name: 校园活动

en.name: Elective (选课网)

plugins.author: pkuinfo

en.name: Finance
en.description: Your stipends and income (Finance portal, campus network only), plus unpaid tuition and housing fees and payment history (payment platform). Read-only.

plugins.author: pkuinfo

en.name: Seminar rooms
en.description: PKU Space: find, book and cancel seminar rooms in the Second and Fourth Teaching Buildings and the Geoscience Building.

plugins.author: pkuinfo

plugins.name: AI 记忆

en.name: AI memory
en.description: Remembers your preferences, habits and long-term details, so the AI gets to know you over time. Stored only on this device; view, edit or delete it any time.

plugins.author: pkuinfo
